subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be finished as docs/help coverage for existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported TUI send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: The dependency already supports Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J newlines, but exposing configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would expand a compatibility-sensitive user preference surface.

options.title: Document Current Behavior First
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Approve TUI Keybinding Bridge
options.body: Wire a supported TUI keybinding/config path into pi-tui for Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter preferences with focused docs and tests.

options.title: Decline Additional Surface
options.body: Treat the dependency-level multiline support as sufficient and close the remaining docs/help/config request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing signal for the TUI docs/help and product-scope decision in this checkout and prior discussion.
